summary: Leggett & Platt filed an 8-K reporting the termination of an aircraft time-sharing agreement with its CEO and shareholder approval of an amended flexible stock plan. The CEO delivered a termination notice effective May 30, 2026, for the aircraft lease (due to planned aircraft sale). Shareholders approved a 4.0 million share increase under the stock plan at the May 21, 2026 annual meeting. The filing includes no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic review are present.
